title: Asha-O-Bhalobasa
desc: Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.

title: Pita Maata Santan
desc: Shikha and Pradeep's marital bliss is shattered when he takes their daughter, Jaya, away. A few years later, fate brings them face to face when Jaya becomes employed in Shikha's company.

title: Putuler Protisodh
desc: Bini, a married woman, is murdered by her in-laws, following which her spirit possesses a doll. As she decides to seek revenge, her husband's second wife must free her spirit.

title: Barkane
desc: Sandip, an unemployed man, refuses a politician's offer to kill Tribeni, his rival. When Tribeni learns about this, she falls in love with him and offers dowry to his father.

title: Rakto Nodir Dhara
desc: Jaga, an international terrorist, avoids a prison term of 21 years by killing multiple people involved in the case. However, the sons of his victims return to seek vengeance.
